content.value: Explain how you would check if two vertices are connected using an adjacency matrix and an adjacency list, and compare the complexities of both methods. Based on your analysis discuss which representation is more suitable for sparse graphs and dense graphs, justifying your answer in terms of both time and space efficiency.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
